title: What Does a Content Marketing Consultant Do & How Do I Hire the Right One? (Infographic) | Brafton

facts.fact: Brafton's article on hiring a content marketing consultant was published on December 17, 2024.
The article defines a content marketing consultant as a person or team hired to give expert advice on creating a content strategy that educates and triggers actions from a specific audience.
facts.quote: Content marketing consultant: A person or team who is hired to give expert advice on creating a content strategy that educates and triggers actions from your specific audience.
